title: test(showcase): add the Reports index to the smoke SURFACES, so /reports stops being a standing hand-walk
body:
domain:devx#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2gLghEqeDKTbDTC7Zd

Filing gate: ① a measured coverage gap in a pinned suite. Found while landing #28641 (W3-C1R row 12, QA run #28545).
Reader: `domain:devx` (or the showcase owner), one PR on `examples/app-showcase/e2e/showcase-smoke.spec.ts` (`SURFACES`) plus the checklist item `platform-core.nav-surfaces-render` (steps[0]/[2]).
Dedupe (open AND closed): "nav_report_index SURFACES" → 3 hits (#28641, #28545, #27377), none proposes the suite edit.
reach: measured from source at `f23e051232`: `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/apps/index.ts` serves 50 `showcase_app` nav leaves; `SURFACES` holds 49; the one outside it is `nav_report_index` (`/reports`).
QA-source: #28545 · platform-core.nav-surfaces-render · steps[0]/[2]
Checklist item priority: P0
type: Bug

Business reason: the P0 smoke is the release's standing evidence. Since #27525 (the console stopped injecting its own "All reports" row), the report index is a served nav leaf like any other, but the pinned suite does not drive it. Every P0 run therefore hand-walks `/reports`, and a regression there is caught only if the runner remembers to. #28641 names it as the standing hand-walk; this card ends that.

## Wanted

- One `SURFACES` entry for the Reports index (`nav_report_index`, `…/reports`), with the same render checks as every other entry.
- In the same PR: `platform-core.nav-surfaces-render` steps[0] says SURFACES covers all 50 leaves, steps[2] drops the standing hand-walk, `revision` +1 with one history row.
- ⛔ The suite's existing checks are unchanged; no entry is removed.
